== Biography ==
James was born 31 May1799 in Rockbridge, Virginia to [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosannah Barclay Glasgow]]<ref>1850 United States Federal Census for James Glasgow</ref>

On 20 Nov 1817 he married [[McNeil-3468|Mary Polly McNeil]] in Adams County, Ohio.<ref>Faris, David, The Glasgow Family of Adams County, Ohio (Baltimore, MD, Gateway Press, Inc., 1990), 39; also listed in DAR records</ref>

They had nine children.

Mary died in 1835.  He then remarried [[Lyle-1916|Sarah Lyle]] on 29 Apr 1836 in Highland, Ohio.<ref>Ohio, U.S., County Marriage Records, 1774-1993 for James Glasgow</ref>

In 1856 he moved with his family to Wayne, Iowa.<ref>Source: Portrait and Biographical Album of Washington County, Iowa (1887). Excerpt from Biographical Sketch of Hon. Robert Glasgow, pages 189-190 accessed at http://iagenweb.org/boards/washington/biographies/index.cgi?read=797779</ref>

He died on 11 Jan, 1875 in Promise City, Wayne County, Iowa.<ref>Iowa, U.S., Wills and Probate Records, 1758-1997 for Jas Glasgow Wayne Probate Case Files, Series 2, 176-271, 1869-1892</ref>

He is buried in the Promise City Cemetery in Promise City, Wayne County, Iowa.<ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/75439597/james-glasgow: accessed May 29, 2024), memorial page for James Glasgow (31 May 1799–10 Jan 1875), Find a Grave Memorial ID 75439597, citing Promise City Cemetery, Promise City, Wayne County, Iowa, USA; Maintained by InSearchOf (contributor 47282406).</ref>

=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''James Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.
